intro: Bhutan has fewer than 800,000 people, mostly Buddhist.

chapters.title: People
text: Dzongkha is the national language, and English is used in schools. Most people are Drukpa Kagyu Buddhists; the Lhotshampa in the south are mostly Hindu.
People wear national dress, the gho for men and the kira for women, at work and in official places.

chapters.title: Life
text: Thimphu, the capital, has no traffic lights; police direct traffic by hand.

keyTerms.meaning: A knee-length robe worn by men.
